snippet.title: Kidbash: Super Legend Official Trailer | #TheIndiePremier
snippet.description:
Awaken with no memory of your past in a forgotten world populated by discarded video game characters. After failing to protect a local village, this nostalgic roguelike action-platformer challenges you to rebuild, rise from defeat, and rediscover what it truly means to be a hero.

Developed by Authentic Remixes and Fat Raccoon, published by Acclaim, Inc.

#TheIndiePremier #GameShowcase #IndieGames #KidbashSuperLegend
